scope: THC Academy summative and credential assessment items

interpretation.minimumResponsesPerItem: Internal operational floor for activation, not a universal psychometric minimum. It prevents trivially small samples from satisfying production readiness; adequacy must still be judged in context.
interpretation.targetResponsesPerItem: Internal stability target for classical item review. Smaller samples may support preliminary analysis but should be interpreted cautiously.
interpretation.reviewSignals: Flags trigger human psychometric/content review. They do not automatically prove an item is good or bad and do not replace content validity review.

sources.title: Educational Measurement, Fifth Edition, Chapter 18: Assessment for Licensing and Certification
sources.publisher: National Council on Measurement in Education
sources.use: Supports the need for defensible validity, reliability and adequate samples in credentialing; notes that small candidate populations complicate field testing and parameter estimation.

sources.title: NBME Item-Writing Guide, Chapter 4: Item Analysis and Interpretation of Results
sources.use: Supports review of item difficulty and discrimination and treats extreme difficulty values as diagnostic signals requiring interpretation.

sources.title: Alternative Methods for Item Parameter Estimation: From CTT to IRT
sources.use: Supports caution when estimating item discrimination with small samples.
